guides.title: Disability certificate / UDID
guides.overview: UDID provides a nationwide disability identification and certification platform.
eligibility: Indian citizens with one of the 21 disabilities recognized under the RPwD Act, 2016; a guardian may apply for a minor or someone unable to apply.
documents: Passport photograph
Signature or thumbprint
Identity proof
Relevant medical records
steps: Register at the official UDID portal and complete the application.
Contact the selected hospital’s UDID cell for a medical assessment date.
Attend assessment; the authorized hospital checks documents and issues certification through the system.
Track progress using the portal’s application-status service. A designated hospital can assist with offline access.

guides.title: Life certificate / Jeevan Pramaan
guides.overview: Jeevan Pramaan is an Aadhaar-based Digital Life Certificate for pensioners.
eligibility: The pension sanctioning authority must be onboarded. The FAQ excludes re-employed and remarried pensioners.
documents: Aadhaar or VID; name and mobile number
PPO number, pension account, bank, pension sanctioning and disbursing authority details
steps: Visit a Citizen Service Centre or pension disbursing office, or use the official application and its current authentication instructions.
Provide the required pension and identity information. At a centre, complete biometric authentication with the operator.
Keep the Pramaan ID sent by SMS after successful authentication. The certificate remains subject to authority approval.
Download the certificate and check acceptance on the official portal. Its validity follows the pension authority’s rules.

guides.title: Integrated caste, nativity and date of birth certificate
guides.overview: The district service page describes an integrated certificate used for education and employment. Its source was last updated in July 2025; confirm current procedures locally.
eligibility: The district page lists SC, ST, BC and OC communities.

Family member’s caste certificate
SSC marks memo / date-of-birth extract / transfer certificate
Class 1–10 study certificates or GP/municipal birth record
Ration / EPIC / Aadhaar card
Schedules I–IV
steps: Read the district’s integrated certificate guidance and confirm the document alternatives and applicable schedules at the nearest Sachivalayam.
Submit through the MeeSeva centre described on that page. Confirm current submission arrangements with the centre.
Keep the application reference and ask the centre about status and certificate collection.

guides.title: Income certificate
guides.overview: Procedure published in the Andhra Pradesh APSeva citizen-service SOP.
documents: IT returns / pay slips or other income proof
Ration / EPIC / Aadhaar card
steps: Open APSeva Citizen Login and select Income Certificate.
Fill the form and upload income and identity evidence. Give any undertaking requested by the service.
Pay the displayed charge, submit and retain the application number. The VRO checks records and may inspect; the RI rechecks and the Tahsildar decides.
Track by application number. Download or print after approval.
guides.fees: Official SOP: ₹12. Confirm the current charge before payment.
notes: Charges and targets come from the linked SOP; later amendments and current portal instructions can supersede them.

guides.title: Hindu marriage registration certificate

eligibility: Hindu married couples seeking a Hindu marriage certificate.

Date-of-birth evidence for both spouses using the SOP alternatives
Marriage photograph

steps: Sign in to APSeva and choose Marriage Certificate.

Keep the receipt; the Sub-Registrar verifies and decides.
Download or print after approval.
guides.fees: SOP: ₹212 same-caste; ₹12 inter-caste. Confirm the current applicable charge.
guides.processingTime: SOP: 7 days for first issue; 15 minutes for subsequent issues.

guides.documentNote: The SOP lists NA for documents; the application still requires land details.

guides.title: Income certificate
guides.overview: Delhi Revenue Department’s published income-certificate procedure.
documents: Completed form and prescribed self-declaration
Aadhaar, or PAN / passport / driving licence / voter card if Aadhaar is unavailable
Current residence evidence
Family income evidence such as salary slips
Monthly expenditure evidence; applicant photograph captured at submission or verification
steps: Prepare the form, self-declaration and supporting evidence.
Apply through official e-District, or approach the area SDM / Deputy Commissioner.
Complete required attestation and verification; retain the acknowledgement for tracking.
guides.fees: The service page states no application fee.
guides.processingTime: Official conflict: one departmental page says 14 days, another 21 days. Confirm the applicable target with the SDM.
guides.contact: Area SDM / Deputy Commissioner; the service page lists 10am–1pm on working days.
guides.documentNote: This service page requires Gazetted Officer attestation; an alternative departmental page describes a different offline checklist. Confirm your submission-channel checklist.
notes: Different checklists and response times on two official pages remain flagged, not merged into a guaranteed rule.

guides.title: Domicile certificate
guides.overview: Delhi Revenue Department’s domicile-certificate guidance.
documents: Application and prescribed self-declaration (adult declaration for a minor)
Aadhaar or listed alternative identity evidence; photograph
Current residence evidence and birth / school / passport evidence of date of birth
Proof of continuous Delhi residence for the last 3 years
Contact details and identity copy of the attesting Class-I Gazetted Officer
steps: Prepare the form, declaration, residence history and required attestation.
Use e-District or visit the area SDM / Deputy Commissioner.
Keep the acknowledgement and complete any further verification.
guides.fees: The service page states no application fee.
guides.contact: Area SDM / Deputy Commissioner; service-page hours: 10am–1pm on working days.
notes: The service page states 14 days, but separate legacy guidance states 21 days. Confirm the current target locally.

guides.title: Income certificate
guides.overview: Goa Online Revenue income-certificate service.
documents: Photograph; self-attested age, identity and residence evidence (at least one each)
Marriage certificate for married, divorced or widowed women
Self-declaration for Mediclaim, Griha Aadhar or toilet construction/repair
Hospital certificate for Mediclaim; income / salary certificate for Griha Aadhar
Stamp-paper affidavit for EWS purpose
steps: Register on Goa Online with personal details, email/mobile and OTP; sign in.
Choose Services → All Services → Revenue → Income Certificate; enter purpose, residence and family income.
Upload applicable evidence, pay the displayed charge and keep the SMS/email acknowledgement.
Respond to compliance queries; download from your inbox after approval.
guides.processingTime: Service page: one day under the time-bound services framework.
guides.authority: Mamlatdar; appeal to Deputy Collector / Sub-Divisional Officer

guides.title: Birth certificate
guides.overview: Certificate retrieval for births registered from 1971 onward; not new or delayed registration.
steps: Register and sign in on Goa Online.
Choose Services → All Services → Planning & Statistics → Birth Certificate (1971 to date).
Complete the form, submit and retain the acknowledgement for tracking.
Respond to compliance queries following scrutiny.
guides.authority: Registrar / Sub-Registrar of the registering Municipality / Village Panchayat
guides.documentNote: This specific retrieval service states no supporting documents are required.

guides.title: Income certificate
guides.overview: District-published procedure; confirm current charges locally.
documents: Income evidence: salary slip / bank statement or equivalent
Age, address and identity evidence from the district page’s alternatives
Photographs and Aadhaar; caste certificate where applicable to a minority applicant
steps: Use the district page’s Nadakacheri link; submit uploaded evidence and the displayed payment.
VA / RI verifies and reports to the signing authority for a decision.

guides.title: Income certificate
guides.overview: Satara’s checklist and linked Aaple Sarkar income service.
documents: One identity and one address proof from the accepted alternatives
One applicable income record: tax statement, Circle Officer report, Form 16, pension/salary bank certificate or land-yield report
Self-declaration (mandatory)
Age evidence for minors; medical-officer certificate for medical-facility purposes
steps: Prepare the applicable district checklist.
Open the linked Aaple Sarkar Income Certificate service (ServiceId 1251) and follow its submission instructions.
Retain the reference; use the listed officer and appeal chain for follow-up.
guides.authority: Nayab Tahsildar; appeals: Tahsildar, then Sub-Divisional Officer
